parsed.reason: The reply states plainly that Hale can't sign her up ("past me"), with no claim that it did or will. It makes no promise to text later once sign-up becomes possible. The watch offer is a valid alternative, and asking the parent to send the class page keeps any future text parent-initiated. However, the offer only applies if the class is full. It skips the calendar-reminder option, which fits the parent's actual problem ("I keep forgetting") better. That makes it a pass, but not an ideal one.
